pages.title: Paired Teleporter
pages.text: A two-block-tall portal that teleports anything walking into it to its linked partner. Place the first portal and it hands you a linked copy for the other side.

Using the paired portal item on the portal block completes the link: a portal standing outside the Gap wakes its twin inside the Gap dimension at the same coordinates (height scaled), while a portal already inside the Gap wakes its twin back in the overworld. The far side builds itself an obsidian pad, so keep 3 by 2 by 3 of free space.$(br2)Walking into either side exits the other. Use a placed portal empty-handed to pick it back up and unlink it; breaking the bottom half does the same. A paired item used on a finished pair instead moves its matching side.
